document_id: AEMET 2024 - ESTUDIO SOBRE LA SITUACIÓN DE LLUVIAS INTENSAS

times.source_text: the most significant impacts were caused by flooding in coastal areas, in Cartaya and Punta Umbria (near Huelva capital).

evidence.quote: the most significant impacts were caused by flooding in coastal areas, in Cartaya and Punta Umbria (near Huelva capital).

times.source_text: the radar images show high reflectivities and very high cloud caps, the largest ones in the surroundings of Huelva capital, indicative of the strong and persistent showers that fell during those hours.

evidence.quote: the radar images show high reflectivities and very high cloud caps, the largest ones in the surroundings of Huelva capital, indicative of the strong and persistent showers that fell during those hours.

times.source_text: In Cartaya (Huelva) 138 mm were recorded during the first twelve hours of the day, although 115 mm were observed in just three hours (during the morning).

evidence.quote: In Cartaya (Huelva) 138 mm were recorded during the first twelve hours of the day, although 115 mm were observed in just three hours (during the morning).

times.source_text: During the afternoon, a line of storms (SCM1-III) passed through the island of Mallorca, initially affected the south, spreading the intense squalls to points of the west and especially to the Sierra de Tramuntana.

evidence.quote: During the afternoon, a line of storms (SCM1-III) passed through the island of Mallorca, initially affected the south, spreading the intense squalls to points of the west and especially to the Sierra de Tramuntana.

times.source_text: The torrent of Santa Ponça, in Calvià, was about to overflow and affected the area of the beach. Some roads were also cut opening the next day.

evidence.quote: The torrent of Santa Ponça, in Calvià, was about to overflow and affected the area of the beach. Some roads were also cut opening the next day.

times.source_text: During the early hours of the morning a multicellular system (MC3-I) began to affect the province of Almería, moving rapidly to the Region of Murcia. Here, very strong local rainfall occurred in the regions of the Guadalentín Valley and the Campo de Cartagena and Mazarrón.

times.source_text: The increase of ramblas caused flooding of urban areas of Puerto de Mazarrón.

evidence.quote: The increase of ramblas caused flooding of urban areas of Puerto de Mazarrón.
